name: audio_cepstral
expr: c1 = cepstralCoefficients(S); c1_1 = c1(1); c1_2 = c1(2); c1_4 = c1(4); c1_6 = c1(6); c2 = cepstralCoefficients(S2); c2_21 = c2(2,1); c2_22 = c2(2,2); c2_24 = c2(2,4); c2_25 = c2(2,5); [mc, md, mdd] = mfcc(xs, fs); mfcc_R = size(mc, 1); mfcc_C = size(mc, 2); mfcc_logE = mc(1,1); mfcc_dc = mc(1,2); mfcc_c2 = mc(1,3); mfcc_cend = mc(1,end); mfcc_f2_dc = mc(2,2);
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycle D + G: cepstralCoefficients (bit-equal — DCT-II unitary matrix from createDCTmatrix.m + log10 rectification, output shape M×NumCoeffs). Tested on single-frame and multi-frame synthetic 8-band spectra. Cycle G upgrade: mfcc now BIT-EQUAL with MATLAB R2025b — uses Slaney band edges (audio.internal.slaneybandedges, 42 entries: 13 linear at 66.66 Hz step + 29 log-spaced ratio 1.0711703), Slaney-style designMelFilterBank ('Hz' designDomain, 'Bandwidth' normalization, 'linear' FilterBankDesignDomain), |FFT| magnitude (NOT |FFT|^2 power), natural-log per-frame energy of UNWINDOWED signal as first column ('append' LogEnergy default), then log10+DCT-II via cepstralCoefficients. Output: numFrames × (NumCoeffs+1). KNOWN GAPs: gtcc still aliases to mfcc (gammatone ERB IIR filterbank deferred to v2). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship cepstralCoefficients/mfcc/gtcc in core (Audio package only).
